description: Execute a requested-wallet buy or sell on a disposable fork of BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base or Arc. Trades the token's market as a scan finds it: its funded V2 pair, else its deepest V3 pool, else its recorded Uniswap V4 pool (hook included), against BNB/WBNB or ETH/WETH; actual wallet balances, EOA wallets only. Returns receipt status, received amount, the market traded (pool_version, pool, fee_tier, hooks), router quote shortfall and gas. A V4 quote already includes the hook's cut. A quote shortfall is not a pure tax or price-impact measurement. Sell approval is simulated when needed; no live transaction is sent. Costs $0.02 per successful call in USDC on Base, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.

amount.description: Input base units: native coin wei (BNB or ETH) for buys, token base units for sells

chain.description: bsc (BNB Smart Chain, the default), eth (Ethereum) or base (Base)

minimum_out.description: Optional minimum received in output base units; defaults to zero

wallet.description: Wallet being tested; may differ from payer

name: simulate-trade
